headline: Tractor Supply Unleashes Another Animal Days Event to Celebrate Pets, Animals and All Those Who Care for Them
summary: BRENTWOOD, Tenn., August 10, 2026--Tractor Supply Company (NASDAQ: TSCO), the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States, announced today that Animal Days are back just in time for the dog days of summer. The two-week event celebrates animals of all kinds and the people and organizations that care for them with exclusive deals, giveaways, adoption events and donations. Leashed pets are invited and encouraged to join in the fun during Animal Days and throughout the year.

thumbnail.caption: Tractor Supply brings back Animal Days, with special deals on essentials for pets and animals, nationwide community 'pawty' and grants to 51 animal shelters across the U.S. alongside Miranda Lambert's MuttNation Foundation.
